# readcon-core

> Reference implementation of the versioned .con and .convel atomistic checkpoint formats, in Rust with C, C++, Python, Julia and Fortran bindings.

- Documentation: https://lode-org.github.io/readcon-core/
- Repository: https://github.com/lode-org/readcon-core
